title: B_B7H3_CAR_T_1
growth_protocol_ch1: Non-tissue culture treated plates were coated with 24 Âµg/mL Retronectin (Tankara) according to the manufactureâ€™s protocol. Frozen B7-H3 retroviral supernatant was thawed in a 37Ëš C water bath and aliquoted into Retronectin coated 6-well plates at 2 ml/well and centrifuged at 32Ëš C for 2.5 hours at 2,000 G. Viral supernatant was discarded after centrifugation and activated PBLs were plated onto retroviral bound plates at a concentration of 5.05 cells/mL and 2 mL per well and incubated overnight. The T cells were transduced once before being rescued from virus and expanded in fresh cTCM media and cytokines. The CAR T cells were transduced twice before being rescued from virus and put into fresh cTCM with fresh cytokines. Half of the medium was changed, and fresh cytokines are added every 2-3 days. The CAR T cells were used for analysis on day 10-14 of culture.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted with a RNeasy mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden Germany).
Libraries were prepared with SMART-Seq v4 3â€™ DE Kit (Takarabio, Japan)
data_processing: Raw reads were filtered by removing reads containing adapter and reads containing N>10% and for Phred scores >30. The filtered reads were analyzed using Partek Flow software version 7.0. Filtered reads were aligned with STAR 2.73a CanFam3.1 genome assembly. Aligned reads were annotated and counted using HTseq
Assembly: CanFam3.1
Supplementary files format and content: txt files contain CPM normalized data
